Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. USA Today poll finds American fathers fear their children becoming gay 2. Jerry Fallwell warns of financial disaster for the anti-gay organization Liberty Christian Academy COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 3. 4th of July Interview with "the Statue of Liberty" (Bill Baumer in a costume) 4. National Association of Business Councils folds 5. Andy Humm discusses the concept of liberty and discrimination COMMERCIAL: Urban General Warehouse Sale 6. House revises the codes prohibiting sexual assault to include men 7. Official Stamp Out AIDS stamps announced 8. HTLVIII antibody found in only 1% of infected persons' saliva 8. Yoga seminars offered to assist those with AIDS in keeping healthy, physically and mentally 9. Washington DC mayor signs into law a bill prohibiting insurance companies from denying coverage to those who test positive for the HTLVIII antibody COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 10. Sport Report 11. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Interview with Kevin Madden discussing volunteering at GMHC 12. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: COMMERCIAL: Freedom Cruise '86 AIDS Benefit 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby, taped recording from Cincinnati Gay Pride COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" magazine 2. Interview with Michael Musto, Village Voice columnist, on his book "Downtown," documenting the night scene in 1980s New York City COMMERCIAL: Body Mate exercise equipment 3. Coverage of the Gay and Lesbian Community Services Center's 3rd Annual Garden Party COMMERCIAL: Water Front Airways
